description: This file defines the PHP class 'TemplateInt', which extends 'TemplateRange' and provides functionality for handling integer-based dynamic field templates within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for rendering HTML editing interfaces, populating object properties from POST data, generating field definitions with validation, and managing auto-increment values.

classes.name: TemplateInt
classes.description: A class representing an integer type dynamic field template, handling validation, rendering, and auto-increment logic.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns the HTML code for editing the field in a form.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates object properties based on POST data, converting 'auto_increment' to boolean.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Generates the field definition array including validation rules and auto-increment settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field definition, updates auto-increment counters if applicable.
